citations.claim: first violation: cart beyond +2.4 track end
one step before, cart just inside limit moving outward fast
earlier approach with positive velocity shows steady drift

counterfactual.change: set initial cart velocity v from 0.27 to 0.0; pole still balanced and cart stays in track, showing outward drift from initial v caused exit

explanation: Controller prioritizes pole balance (theta stays ~0.08 rad, force ~0.6 << limit) over cart centering, so initial outward velocity 0.27 m/s is never reversed and cart drifts steadily to exit the 2.4m track. Zeroing initial v removes the failure.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.406 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart is at the far right end of the track with the pole remaining nearly upright in all four frames. At step 486 the cart is marked as violating but shows almost no motion between frames, indicating a slow drift off the track rather than a pole fall.
